# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(writexl)
  library(methylGSA)
  library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
get_analysis_results <- function(label) {
  save_name <- file.path(
    save_dir,
    "linear_model",
    paste0("EAP_stats_bacon_", label, ".csv")
  )

  stats_df <- read.csv(save_name)

  stats_df
}
```

## Run methylRRA Analysis

```{r func_methylrra}
get_go_biology <- function() {
  m_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP"
  )
  target_ls <- m_df %>%
    dplyr::pull("gs_exact_source") %>%
    unique()

  target_ls
}

# methylRRA GSEA for one gene set collection, sorted by P-value and labeled
# with the collection name in the method column
run_methylrra <- function(cpg_ls, array.type, gs_type) {
  set.seed(23)
  methylGSA::methylRRA(
    cpg.pval = cpg_ls,
    array.type = array.type,
    method = "GSEA",
    GS.type = gs_type,
    minsize = 5,
    maxsize = 200
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(method = gs_type)
}

# Keep pathways with at least `min_genes` core enrichment genes
filter_core_enrichment <- function(pathway_df, min_genes = 3) {
  pathway_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      core_enrichment_count = stringr::str_count(
        .data$core_enrichment, "[/]"
      ) + 1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$core_enrichment_count >= min_genes)
}

get_cpg_pathways <- function(cpg_ls, array.type = c("450K", "EPIC")) {
  array.type <- match.arg(array.type)

  kegg_df <- run_methylrra(cpg_ls, array.type, "KEGG") %>%
    filter_core_enrichment()

  react_df <- run_methylrra(cpg_ls, array.type, "Reactome") %>%
    filter_core_enrichment()

  # GO is restricted to biological processes, with the FDR recomputed for them
  bio_ls <- get_go_biology()
  go_df <- run_methylrra(cpg_ls, array.type, "GO") %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$ID %in% bio_ls) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(padj = stats::p.adjust(.data$pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
    filter_core_enrichment()

  rbind(kegg_df, react_df, go_df)
}

get_stats_pathways <- function(stats_df, array.type = c("450K", "EPIC")) {
  array.type <- match.arg(array.type)

  cpg_ls <- stats_df %>%
    dplyr::pull("pvalue_bacon", name = "CpG")

  pathway_df <- get_cpg_pathways(cpg_ls, array.type = array.type)

  pathway_df
}

get_pathway_annotation <- function(pathway_df, anno_df) {
  anno_df <- anno_df %>%
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(
      c("UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Group"), delim = ";"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      UCSC_RefGene_Name = trimws(.data$UCSC_RefGene_Name),
      UCSC_RefGene_Group = trimws(.data$UCSC_RefGene_Group)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  gene_df <- pathway_df %>%
    dplyr::select("ID", "core_enrichment") %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows("core_enrichment", sep = "/") %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::rename(UCSC_RefGene_Name = "core_enrichment") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(anno_df, by = "UCSC_RefGene_Name", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  gene_df
}

run_pathway_analysis <- function(
    stats_df, anno_df, array.type = c("450K", "EPIC")
) {
  array.type <- match.arg(array.type)

  pathway_df <- get_stats_pathways(stats_df, array.type = array.type)

  gene_df <- get_pathway_annotation(pathway_df, anno_df)

  list(pathway_df = pathway_df, gene_df = gene_df)
}
```

## Save Results

```{r func_save}
# Pathways from one method (KEGG, Reactome, or GO), without the method column
get_method_pathways <- function(pathway_df, method_name) {
  pathway_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$method == method_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"method")
}

# Genes of the nominally significant (P < 0.05) pathways from one method
get_method_genes <- function(gene_df, pathway_df, method_name) {
  signif_ids <- pathway_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$method == method_name) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::pull("ID")

  gene_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$ID %in% signif_ids)
}

save_pathway_analysis <- function(pathway_df, gene_df, label) {
  write_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "eQTM_probes")

  writexl::write_xlsx(
    list(
      KEGG = get_method_pathways(pathway_df, "KEGG"),
      Reactome = get_method_pathways(pathway_df, "Reactome"),
      GO = get_method_pathways(pathway_df, "GO"),
      Kegg_Genes = get_method_genes(gene_df, pathway_df, "KEGG"),
      Reactome_Genes = get_method_genes(gene_df, pathway_df, "Reactome"),
      GO_Genes = get_method_genes(gene_df, pathway_df, "GO")
    ),
    file.path(write_dir, paste0(label, "_methylGSA_pathway_analysis.xlsx"))
  )
}
```

## Wrapper Functions

```{r func_wrapper}
run_full_analysis <- function(label) {
  stats_df <- get_analysis_results(label = label)
  anno_df <- stats_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Name = "CpG",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Group"
    )

  stats_res <- run_pathway_analysis(stats_df, anno_df, array.type = "EPIC")
  pathway_df <- stats_res$pathway_df
  gene_df <- stats_res$gene_df

  save_pathway_analysis(pathway_df, gene_df, label = label)

  pathway_df
}
```

## Plot

```{r func_plot}
plot_pathway <- function(pathway_df, title, thresh_fdr = 0.05, ylim = 1e-5) {
  plot_df <- pathway_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$padj <= thresh_fdr) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(logp = -log10(.data$pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      signif = ifelse(.data$padj < 0.05, "Significant", "Not_significant"),
      ordering = dplyr::row_number(),
      label = ifelse(nchar(.data$Description) < 80, .data$Description, .data$ID),
      label = factor(.data$label, levels = .data$label)
    )

  group.colors <- c(Significant = "#6496CD", Not_significant = "#D55E00")

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df, mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = label, y = logp, fill = signif)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(orientation = "x", width = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      limits = c(0, -log10(ylim)),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f", x),
      breaks = seq(0, -log10(ylim), by = 2)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group.colors) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::ylab(expression("-log"["10"]~"(p)")) +
    ggplot2::xlab("") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(title) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0.5, b = 0.5, unit = "cm")
      ),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  p
}
```

# Run Analysis for DNAm*pTau

```{r analyze_interact}
pathway_df <- run_full_analysis(label = "interact")
```

## Plot KEGG

```{r kegg_interact, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 12}

  thresh_fdr = 0.30,

)
```
